newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: German climber is fourth to die on Matterhorn.
newsitem.headline: German climber is fourth to die on Matterhorn.

text.p: A 69-year-old German man fell to his death while climbing the Matterhorn, the fourth Alpinist to die on Switzerland's most famous mountain since mid-July, police said on Thursday.
They said the unnamed German fell 400 metres (1,300 feet) while climbing the east face of the Matterhorn with a companion. The cause of the fall was not known.
The accident happened late on Wednesday but the body was not recovered until Thursday because of fog and storms around the 4,477-metre (14,600 feet) peak on the Swiss-Italian border, police said.
At least 32 climbers have died in the Swiss Alps since mid-July as the summer tourist season coincided with a treacherous high-altitude mix of snow, heat and thunderstorms.
